source: de Regt et al. (2025), The ESO SupJup Survey VII, A&A 696, A225, Table 2 (tab:params), Luhman 16A one-column retrieval (https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.21266)
band: VLT/CRIRES+ J1226 setting (1.1-1.4 um); not a visible band

u2.fixed: The survey broadens its model spectra with PyAstronomy's fastRotBroad and "linear limb-darkening coefficient epsilon_limb" (SupJup Survey I, de Regt et al. 2025, https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.10841): a linear law, so the quadratic term is zero

note: Fitted with the rotational broadening to the CRIRES+ J-band spectrum of Luhman 16A itself; the only limb law measured for it. The two-column retrieval gives 0.44 +0.05 -0.04, inside this range. It is an infrared law: the visible limb is not measured, and no model table reaches a 1,300 K dwarf.
